data.name: PackageSetupHelp
data.value:
WallpaperControl needs your personal Ship24 API key for package tracking. The free plan currently supports up to 10 new shipments per month.
1. Open the Ship24 Tracking API plan and select FREE. 2. Create a Ship24 account or sign in. 3. Open “Developers” in the dashboard. 4. Under “API Keys”, find the automatically created “Default” key. 5. Select “Copy” and paste the key below.
